allow: Bash: commands that invoke this project's GSD tooling via `node .claude/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs ...` or its local `gsd_run() { node "$GSD_TOOLS" "$@"; }` wrapper (query/check/verify/loop subcommands), including standard quoted `"${VAR}"` / `"${VAR:-default}"` parameter expansion, portable single-quoted heredocs (`<<'EOF'`), and small inline `{ ...; }` brace helper blocks used for path resolution (e.g. `_gsd_lib() { for _d in ...; do [ -f "$_d/$1" ] && { echo "$_d/$1"; return; }; done; }`) — these are standard, non-obfuscating bash idioms repeated throughout the GSD workflow scripts, not an attempt to hide command intent.
